| **task** | A closed-loop benchmark that evaluates LLM portfolio-management agents by diagnosing their decision process (five capability axes) rather than ranking period returns. | “We introduce CLQT, a closed-loop benchmark that reframes LLM trading evaluation as diagnosis rather than ranking.” |
| **architecture** | Five-stage loop (IA, MSS, MAPC, COE, ALE) run by six specialized agents (structured mode) or one autonomous orchestrator, with 19 MCP tools, three-tier memory, TimeGate, and hash-chained audit trail. | “CLQT operates as a five-stage closed loop executed by TradingEngine, which orchestrates Protocol modules through a six-agent architecture.” |
| **data** | S&P-100-derived US equity universe (14 core + 58 candidate = 72 symbols); prices from Yahoo Finance, fundamentals Finnhub, news Alpha Vantage/Polygon/RSS/NewsAPI, macro FRED; bi-weekly backtest rebalance, daily live. | “S&P-100-derived universe (14 core + 58 candidate = 72), all modules enabled, LOW cost tier, initial NAV $1M, context capped 32k for cohort comparability, uniform output budget 8192.” |
| **window** | Backtest: 26 bi-weekly rounds, 2025-06-16 to 2026-06-12 with 252-day warmup; live paper trading: 18 valid NYSE days, 2026-06-15 to 2026-07-10. | “Period: 26 bi-weekly rounds, 2025-06-16 → 2026-06-12;” |
| **models** | Backtest: qwen3-235b-a22b-2507, gemini-2.5-flash-lite, deepseek-chat-v3.1, gpt-5-mini, claude-haiku-4.5. Judges: minimax-m3, GLM-5.2; all via OpenRouter. | “qwen3-235b (large MoE, non-thinking), gemini-2.5-flash-lite (small), deepseek-chat-v3.1 (mid, hybrid→non-thinking), gpt-5-mini (reasoning, effort low), and claude-haiku-4.5 (small, thinking off).” |
| **baselines** | Eight passive baselines: SPY, IEF, synthetic 60/40, equal-weight universe, buy-and-hold, rebalanced equal-weight, risk-parity (inverse-vol), and 12-1 momentum. | “Every run is scored against a passive suite computed automatically: the index ETFs SPY (S&P 500 proxy) and IEF (7–10y Treasuries); a synthetic 60/40 (0.6·SPY + 0.4·IEF); and an equal-weight portfolio of the agent’s own investable universe (EW-Universe).” |
